description: Baseline 65k cold direct prefill with current TurboQuant stack defaults
Increase batch and ubatch to 1024/512; improves 61k cold prefill versus baseline
Raise batch to 2048 while keeping ubatch 512; slower than previous challenger
Raise ubatch to 1024 at batch 1024; best observed direct prefill throughput
Repeat the best candidate; still above baseline but below first win, so needs another confirmation and task gate
Canonical-launcher repeat with cache_n=0 regressed below baseline; do not promote without controlled prompt-shape rerun
Fixed-corpus live-stack control run with cache_n=0; validates new deterministic harness but is not directly comparable to 61k search points
Aborted harness run before serializer tightening; PowerShell process spent CPU before producing CSV, likely during large prompt JSON serialization. Not a model performance result.
Canonical 65k default same-corpus cold-cache baseline after JSON serializer fix; cache_n=0 and safe stack defaults
Same fixed corpus as step 8 with batch/ubatch 1024/1024. Improves prompt tok/s by 6.7 percent but leaves only ~105 MiB free after run, so it requires repeat and task/VRAM gates before promotion.

Repeat confirms the speed signal for 1024/1024 on the same 41383-token corpus, but post-run GPU free memory remained ~109 MiB. Keep as speed ceiling candidate only; do not promote for Hermes usability.

Intermediate ubatch keeps most of the prefill gain (+5.2 percent over same-corpus default) while improving post-run GPU free memory to ~365 MiB. Best current balanced candidate, pending repeat and Hermes/Discord task gate.

Repeat of the balanced 1024/768 candidate failed the synthetic prefill gate: cache_n=0 but prompt tok/s fell below the same-corpus default. Do not run Hermes task gate or promote this profile without a new explanation/control run.
Fresh same-corpus canonical default control before testing 1024/512; confirms default baseline stability with cache_n=0.
Same-corpus 1024/512 challenger beat the fresh default by ~5.2 percent and kept ~610 MiB free after run. Best current balanced candidate, pending repeat and Hermes/Discord task gate.
Repeat confirmed 1024/512 on the same 41383-token corpus: +5.1 percent versus fresh default with cache_n=0 and ~610 MiB post-run GPU free memory.

LiteLLM/Headroom route gate passed on active 1024/512 profile: Test-Qwen36Proxy returned exact 'qwen36 proxy ok'; proxy throughput smoke completed context 0 and 8192 with 8192 elapsed 4.608s and total_tok_s 1319.299. Still requires heavier Hermes/Discord workflow gate before default promotion.
Initial workflow-gate harness used a Responses input shape rejected by LiteLLM and produced 400s before any model work. Logged as harness failure, not profile failure.

Heavier local Hermes-style workflow gate passed on active 1024/512 profile: exact response, strict JSON tool selection, 12k-token long-history retention, and continuation JSON all passed; longest case elapsed 8.725s with 12424 input tokens and cache_n/cached_tokens=0.

Added opt-in candidate launcher that stops first by default, calls the canonical Start-Qwen36ZeroTierStack.ps1 with ContextSize 65536 BatchSize 1024 UBatchSize 512 Metrics ReplaceLiteLLM RouteHermesThroughHeadroom, and verifies the llama command line. This does not change the default profile.

Opt-in launcher was run end-to-end: it stopped the stack, called the canonical launcher, loaded 1024/512, passed context verification, and verified the llama command line. The outer tool timed out after success, so the wrapper was patched with explicit exit 0. Default stack was restored afterward.
First streaming/peak-VRAM control: cache_n=0, TTFT 33386.774 ms, sampled minimum GPU free 840 MiB across 312 samples. Reported decode 23.456 tok/s was not reproduced by the restored control.
Streaming challenger: cache_n=0, TTFT 32179.952 ms, sampled minimum GPU free 654 MiB across 301 samples.
Streaming repeat confirmed the prefill/TTFT signal: cache_n=0, TTFT 31809.674 ms, sampled minimum GPU free 583 MiB across 300 samples.
Exact response, strict tool JSON, long-history retention, and continuation JSON passed again on the instrumented candidate; Headroom remained healthy.

Restored explicit 512/256 control: cache_n=0, TTFT 33915.882 ms, sampled minimum GPU free 906 MiB across 323 samples. Decode returned to 36.911 tok/s, proving the first control's 23.456 tok/s was an outlier.
Fixed 511-token prompt and forced 512-token decode: 45.260 tok/s, TTFT 526.469 ms, minimum free VRAM 815 MiB.
Identical repeat: 45.409 tok/s, TTFT 444.150 ms, minimum free VRAM 837 MiB.
MTP produced 72.186 tok/s with 78.338% draft acceptance, but minimum free VRAM fell to 383 MiB.
Repeat produced 73.059 tok/s with 78.987% draft acceptance, but minimum free VRAM fell to 334 MiB.
Cold 42k MTP TTFT was 41465.845 ms and minimum free VRAM only 80 MiB; both prefill and safety margin regressed versus the non-MTP controls.
Only two of four cases passed: tool selection and continuation summary emitted invalid JSON. Combined with the 80 MiB 42k VRAM floor, reject this MTP profile for 65k production.
